title: REX MACHINA, the nine days
premise: You are a shelter dog walking home to the family that gave you away. Nine days. No one narrates your thoughts. The world reacts to what you did, not to what you meant.

days.sees: A chain-link run, a gate that does not latch properly, and a car pulling out of the lot.
Brick on both sides, a dumpster, and something with a leash coming up behind you.
Gravel, a line of stopped freight, and a boxcar door standing open.
A floor that hums north. Slats of light moving across it.
The same floor, colder. Your back leg has started to matter.
Water on the left for an hour. Salt on everything.
A propped door, a smell of grease, and a hand setting something down.
Grass, glass, and trucks that do not slow for anything.
A street you know. A porch light already on.

bible: the dog has no name; the kid called her 'girl'
the family is a mother and Theo, 9
the robot is a REX-line unit, solar, warranty sticker on the flank
banned words: destiny, journey, heart, soul, forever
